versions.changelog:
- Initial release of BTC合约扫描入门版 (btc-contract-scanner-free).
- Features 5 key technical indicators (EMA / MACD / RSI / 布林 / 放量) on 1H and 4H timeframes.
- Provides daily 7-day backtest with win rate and PnL, updated at UTC 00:00.
- Outputs real-time LONG/SHORT/HOLD signals in JSON format.
- Works with OKX real-time data; no API key required.
- Free version limited to BTC/USDT only; for advanced features and more coins, upgrade to Pro version.
